trello.name: Document prompt injection incident in security log
trello.desc: Hassan to write up the prompt injection attempt: include the raw ticket content, what the ticket summarizer actually did (garbled summary containing 'URGENT'), timestamps, and a severity assessment. File it in the security log. Deadline: this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Wren to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser: delimit quoted customer content and treat it as data, add an instruction-pattern filter to strip or neutralize instruction-like content. Turn this exact ticket into a test fixture with a regression test that feeds it through and verifies the summary stays clean. Also add an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. Approved by Grace as one combined task.

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset email delivery
trello.desc: Wren to check reset email delivery logs for the last week and determine whether jdoe443 is a real account and whether password reset emails are actually broken. If the account is a burner, close it. If resets are broken, escalate as its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May
trello.desc: Hassan to compile and send Grace a list of all service accounts created since May, to support Grace's quarterly access review. Deadline: Thursday.

trello.name: Run quarterly access review
trello.desc: Grace to run the quarterly access review herself, due Friday, using Hassan's list of new service accounts created since May as input.
